description: Read a local CSV / XLSX / TSV / TXT file. Returns parsed rows as an array of objects when possible. Bound by WB_FS_MAX_BYTES and WB_FS_MAX_ROWS. GATE: on a multi-sheet workbook called WITHOUT a `sheet` (and not as_text), this returns { success:false, blocked:true, sheets:[…] } — ask the user which worksheet to use, then re-call with that `sheet` name (do NOT guess the tab).

as_text.description: If true, return the file's raw UTF-8 text instead of parsing. Useful for JSON / TXT inspection.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to read.

max_rows.description: Cap the number of data rows returned (defaults to WB_FS_MAX_ROWS).

name: read_local_file
